content.text: Node isn't permitted here, so I'll review app.js by reading it instead.

I've fixed all six bugs and added the three features, but none of it has been run. Running Node here needed approval, so I checked the code by reading it instead. It's worth clicking through each case in a browser once.

**Bug fixes**
1. **Monthly repeat from the 31st** (`js/recurring.js`): months that don't have that day used to be skipped. The date now moves to the last day of the month, so Jan 31 repeats on Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30.
2. **CSV line breaks** (`js/csv.js`): the importer split the file into lines before reading quotes, which cut quoted descriptions in half. It now reads the whole file at once, so line breaks inside quotes stay part of the description.
3. **Wrong row deleted** (`js/app.js`): Delete used the row's position in the filtered or sorted list instead of its position in the full list. It now uses the real position.
4. **Refunds counted as spending** (`js/budget.js`): budgets added up amounts ignoring their sign. Now only negative amounts (expenses) count, so refunds are ignored.
5. **Balance decimals**: the balance now always shows two decimals (749.50).
6. **Reload goes to transactions**: on load, the app always forced the transactions view. It now opens the view in the page address (`#/budgets`, `#/reports`), and still defaults to transactions.

**Features**
- **A. Edit**: each row now has an Edit button next to Delete. It fills the form with that transaction, and #add then saves over it instead of adding a row. #cancel-edit is new (placed next to #add) and leaves edit mode. #undo reverts an edit. A few related behaviours: starting an edit sets Repeat to "none"; Undo, Redo or deleting the row you're editing also leaves edit mode; and #cancel-edit stays visible all the time.
- **B. Rename**: the budgets view has new #rename-from, #rename-to and #rename. Only exact matches are renamed, after trimming spaces from both names. One #undo restores the old names on transactions, but budgets keep the new name, because undo history only covers transactions.
- **C. Report change column**: the report has a third column showing this month minus last month (+12.50, -20.00, or 0.00). Categories that only had transactions last month also get a row, with a total of 0.00. December's previous month is November, and January's is December of the year before.

All existing ids, classes and module exports are unchanged. I also added a small style for the Edit button in `styles.css`.
